title: Illicit
summary: ILLIC'IT, adjective [Latin illicitus; in and licitus, from liceo, to permit.] Not permitted or allowed; prohibited; unlawful; as an illicit trade; illicit intercourse or connection.

inlines.v: ILLIC'IT, adjective [Latin illicitus; in and licitus, from liceo, to permit.] Not permitted or allowed; prohibited; unlawful; as an illicit trade; illicit intercourse or connection.
